= <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Temple of Aminishi Basic</nowiki></span> =
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed pvme-export-media-meta" style="margin:0.8em 0;padding:0.6em 0.8em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%;"><strong>Contents</strong><div class="mw-collapsible-content" style="max-height:24em;overflow:auto;">
{{ToC|align=none|clear=none|width=100%|limit=2}}
</div></div>


<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/LdYq2RP.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>ED1 is a very consistent money-maker and a good avenue for players to practice using AoE abilities, movement, avoiding damaging mechanics and DPS rotations. The requirements to feasibly solo it are moderate and many deaths should be expected when learning the dungeon due to the nature of the mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use the zerker aura </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="berserker">[[File:Berserker aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>|<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reckless">[[File:Reckless aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>|<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mani">[[File:Maniacal aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mani</nowiki>|<nowiki>mani</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> variants for the dungeon. Otherwise, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vamp">[[File:Vampyrism aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vamp</nowiki>|<nowiki>vamp</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is fine for learning, but prioritise using defence reducing abilities for special attacks (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="quake">[[File:Quake.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>quake</nowiki>|<nowiki>quake</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) on Masuta and Seiryu's face. Also, expect to do additional cycles on Seiryu.</nowiki></p>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-sanctum-guardian-info" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>The Sanctum Guardian (Info)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/KCgIv13UAG.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The first boss you encounter. Sanctum uses primarily slow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks which hit moderately hard. However, they are aimed at the players' tile instead of character so you are able to dodge them by stepping away 3 or more tiles before they hit.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div>
<div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255);"></div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u>
</div>

<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum's attack pattern is:
    • Start of fight: 4x Ranged autoattack to start the fight.
    • Rest of fight: Water Burst → Ranged auto → Water Jet → Ranged auto → Purple Smoke → Melee auto → repeat
    • After the 4th water jet attack, 2 Crassian Reinforcements are summoned.
    • The melee auto does nothing if you are out of melee range.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ranged Autoattacks</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ A projectile that targets the spot the player is standing on and hits in a 3x3 area. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/r63xxBI.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Targeted to a tile rather than the player and has travel time before it hits
    • It is possible to dodge every Ranged autoattack simply by moving before the attack lands (not necessary).
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Water Burst</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum ducks down and rises back up quickly, splashing water and dealing heavy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/TJngvfo.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as soon as you see this mechanic as it is very fast. You can also </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> this if needed.
    • Staying or moving out of range in time will cause the attack to miss. Doing this is usually unnecessary. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/3xDLQIAMeEc <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Water Jet</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum spews water, rotating from North anti-clockwise, dealing ~6000 soft typeless damage if the player is caught in it. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/xbJwXJj.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • This mechanic can be avoided by moving to dodge it or via </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.
    • You can also </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to reduce the damage if need be, although these are less efficient.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Purple Smoke</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ A blue bar appears above your character. When it drains, a cloud of smoke will cover a 5x5 area centred around your location. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/CCIKuCR.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The smoke deals rapid typeless damage every tick which increases very fast, hitting ~4000 a tick eventually. Move out of it as soon as possible.
    • Move to the place you want to drop it walk out after it drops. Don't panic and walk around unnecessarily, causing you to drop it in an undesirable position.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>


</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-sanctum-guardian-fight-tips" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>The Sanctum Guardian (Fight tips)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ You may die a few times because the mechanics are quite fast and arguably hard to react to. This is perfectly normal.</nowiki></p>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ An easy way to dodge Water Jet if fighting Sanctum from the front is standing east then walking west as follows:</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/OSdmLyz.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you don't wish to teleport out to bank before Sanctum, go to the back and fight while standing along this thing so that Anagamis and Arhats following you get stuck as shown below and do not bother you during the fight.</nowiki></p>

<span id="masuta-the-ascended-info" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Masuta, the Ascended (Info)</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/l1tE0lAhOH.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Masuta is the second boss of ED1. Expect to eat a lot of food during this fight. Masuta is a fairly hard fight, dealing both high burst and sustained damage on the player. He is considered by some to be the hardest in the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u>
</div>

<div><div><div><u><nowiki>P1 Rotation</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta attacks at the fight using the following rotation:
    • 2-4 autos → Hurricane → 3-5 autos → Tsunami → 3-5 autos → Repeats from Hurricane.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Autoattack information</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta mostly uses </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during p1, occasionally using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> [https://img.pvme.io/images/lQiGv8Y.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Occasionally, he summons a clone while using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> which deals an additional hit. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/VrBObJ5.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ It is important to block these doubled autos with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hurricane</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta starts spinning for about 12 seconds, hitting nearby players for increasing Melee damage once per tick, chasing after you at walking speed during this attack.
    • The best way to deal with this is </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 1 GCD after the attack starts, allowing you to deal damage in MD and nullifies most of the damage you take.
    • If using ranged, you may kite Masuta and use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="deathsswiftpf">https://files.catbox.moe/d7mdi4.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> once he finishes spinning.
    • It's possible to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="flankicon">[[File:Flanking.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>flankicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>flankicon</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Masuta from the north side during this attack.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Tsunami</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ After Hurricane, Masuta returns to autoing, usually around the 4th, 5th or 6th autoattack, purple waters appear around the arena. The purples water thrash about while Masuta uses 3 more autos. Right after the 3rd auto, Masuta uses a Tsunami on his target. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/zHMArnZ.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • These hit you with two extremely high (7k+) </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits.
        ⬩ This can be dealt with by using both </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after Masuta's 3rd autoattack. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/WZlGkkmUsis <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ You can also move far enough to avoid getting hit. This can be done by either running or using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as the auto before the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="tsunami">[[File:Tsunami.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>tsunami</nowiki>|<nowiki>tsunami</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/qrcCqidKhe0 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pulverise</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ After Tsunami, for the rest of Phase 1 Masuta may use Pulverise instead of an auto, dealing moderate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/LvR5mBE.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • You can use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or run 2 tiles away to avoid this.
        ⬩ You only have 1 tick to move far enough when the text 'I'll pulverise you!' appears.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Waters</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Once his HP reaches 275k, Masuta will stop attacking, start levitating, reducing all damage to 1. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/Fe0ihJk.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Thrashing waters will start spawning randomly periodically. They have 8000 HP and a very long-ranged </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> autoattack.
    • Up to 15 Thrashing Waters will be spawned over 90s.
    • Pray Deflect Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • When a water is killed, players within a 2 tiles receive a 5% Calm Waters buff. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/gvMdd2v.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ This reduces the damage from Tsunamis in next phase relative to the percentage of the buff.
    • Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="excal">[[File:Augmented enhanced Excalibur.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>excal</nowiki>|<nowiki>excal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to sustain HP during this phase and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> whenever it comes up to reduce damage taken.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last phase</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta yells 'These waters will choke you where you stand!' and returns to the floor from his levitation. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/W6v0V4g.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • After he resumes attacking, he always does 2 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> autos followed by a Tsunami.
    • For the rest of the phase, Masuta will cycle between using 3-6 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> autos and then a powerful </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Tsunami attack.
    • Standing far away can help with prayer flicking as both autos and Tsunami will hit later.
    • The magic attack has a travel time based on distance. While in MD the attack hits you instantly, while Ranged autoattacks take 1 tick to hit you.
    • As Masuta has an attack speed of 4 ticks, by rotating your overhead prayers </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulsplit">[[File:Soul Split.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulsplit">[[File:Soul Split.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectRange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → repeat, you will always be praying correctly.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>


</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="masuta-the-ascended-fight-tips" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Masuta, the Ascended (Fight tips)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ You may want to bank or use a preset with more food for this encounter.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you receive a second Hurricane special (where </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is down), try to stay as far away from Masuta as possible. Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Using channelled abilities such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="destroy">[[File:Destroy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>|<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="snipe">https://files.catbox.moe/vq3z03.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> will help you avoid getting walked while Masuta spins.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This does not work on channelled special attacks such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="armadylbattlestaff">[[File:Armadyl battlestaff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>armadylbattlestaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>armadylbattlestaff</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and you will get walked</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation outlines:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rotations are to be used at the start and then repeated after waters to finish Masuta off.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will need to be used some time after the first threshold, unless you are kiting</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="limitless">[[File:Limitless.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>|<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" <p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can also </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> an occasional waters auto if needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When Masuta resumes attacking after waters, make sure you are high HP as he will do 2 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> autos while you are probably still finish off the remaining waters, which deal </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage. This damage can stack you out if not careful.</nowiki></p>

<span id="seiryu-the-azure-serpent-info" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Seiryu, the Azure Serpent (Info)</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/dksAPM9sP5.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Seiryu is the final boss of ED1 and attacks using primarily </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div>
<div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255);"></div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u>
</div>

<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Face (7500k-7200k HP)</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu first does 4 attacks then continues with the following attack rotation
    • Huge Breath → 2 attacks → Shadow Energy → 2 attacks → repeat
    • Seiryu's standard attack is either a slow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack (easy to flick) or a tail blackhole.
    • The 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic will be replaced by the Black Hands mechanic.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Tail Blackhole</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu dips his tail into the floor to summon a black hole under the player. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/zwFuDq4.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Summoned blackholes will cover a 2x2 area, dealing rapid and increasing damage (~2000 per tick) to players standing on them, lasting for about 10 seconds before disappearing.
    • Move out (1 tile north/east or 2 tiles south/west) of it to avoid damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Huge Breath</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ The message 'Seiryu takes a huge breath!' appears and Seiryu will swing his head from east to west while doing a breath attack. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/fsznjRq.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • This deals ~8000 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack unprotected.
    • You can dodge this attack by standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena. Alternatively, use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.
    • The hit lands when Seiryu's head reaches west making it easy to react to.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shadow Energy</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ The game message 'Shadow energy bursts forth from Seiryu.' appears, and Seiryu launches a shadow projectile towards a tile marked by an arrow. Shortly after, highly damaging black hands will move from the marked tile towards your current location. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/0NPw0Ot.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Move out of the way when the black hands spawn.
    • The hands have moderate KO potential so be careful especially if the projectile lands near you.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Black Hands</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Replaces Seiryu's 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic. Black hands spawn from a random point along the south wall and move north, expanding out in V-shape pattern. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/4YRp1Ra.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • These hands are extremely damaging, avoiding them is vital.
    • Take extremely caution especially if using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and don't stand directly at the south wall when this mechanic is imminent.
    • Once this mechanic has been cast, a new set of black hands will spawn when the current formation is complete.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shackle</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ At 7200k HP, Seiryu stops his attacks and lowers his head, all existing mechanics then disappear. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/6UThIKD.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • You will be able to climb the shackle at these two points and start damaging the Black Crystals on the shackle. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ia7OVYS.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The crystals have 150K HP and can be damaged using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dommine">[[File:Dominion mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. The fight ends once all of them are destroyed.
    • After some time, 6 shadow enigmas will spawn and slowly move towards Seiryu. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/NqEDUWE.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ Upon reaching his face, enigmas will heal crystals by 50k HP each. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/c7V97dw.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ Ignore the first set of enigmas and DPS the crystals.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Post-Shackle</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ After the 6th heal is finished, you have 13.2 seconds before you get stunned and teleported back down from the shackle.
    • During this time, a second set of enigmas will have spawned.
        ⬩ Tag and kill them before attacking Seiryu.
    • Seiryu heals back to 7500k HP. Get him down to below 7200k again to continue killing the black crystals.
    • After dragging you down, Seiryu will always start with a Huge Breath attack before continuing his attacking rotation from the previous phase.
        ⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> before getting dragged down, and walk to the south wall while tagging and killing the enigmas to avoid the breath.
        ⬩ Continue attacking Seiryu afterwards.
    • If you kill all 3 crystals during the first shackle segment, the fight ends and this portion will not happen.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>


</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="seiryu-the-azure-serpent-fight-tips" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Seiryu, the Azure Serpent (Fight tips)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu can be </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="flankicon">[[File:Flanking.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>flankicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>flankicon</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> permanently when standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be careful of the V-shaped Shadow Hands if doing this.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ HP can be sustained very easily if </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulsplit">[[File:Soul Split.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> flicking.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not, the easiest way to sustain your HP without needing much food is using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on the huge breath attack.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Move as little you need to avoid the shadow mechanics, to avoid negatively affecting your DPS.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1 tile east for blackholes.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2-3 tiles to avoid hands from shadow energy.</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/ktXTzON.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ For learners, you will likely start off with 3-cycling Seiryu, eventually being able to 2-cycle once comfortable with the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Start of fight:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your damage boosting ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="sunshinepf">https://files.catbox.moe/1xp67e.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="deathsswiftpf">https://files.catbox.moe/d7mdi4.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> to start the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use abilities until Seiryu phases. Do not use your ultimate again.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Seiryu is at around 7250k, build to 100% adrenaline and prepare to jump.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Seiryu lowers his head, quickly go to either jump tile and go up ASAP. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="bdmobile">https://files.catbox.moe/tohv08.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> there if you can.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Shackle:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> immediately.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill the first crystal and build until the first waves of heals are complete, then get in as much damage on the second crystal as possible until you get dragged down.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dommine">[[File:Dominion mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> immediately once they're off cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Post-shackle:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Immediately tag and kill enigmas when you are on the ground.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your damage boosting ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="sunshinepf">https://files.catbox.moe/1xp67e.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="deathsswiftpf">https://files.catbox.moe/d7mdi4.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> again on Seiryu and repeat what you did at the start.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Second shackle:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you had a lot of time left after killing the first crystal during the first shackle, go for a 2-cycle.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jump up from a different side to attack the crystal at full HP.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span> <span the middle crystal with your strongest abilities afterwards.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the remaining crystal has too much health for you to finish off before the heals start, do a 3rd cycle.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="mobs-and-movement" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Mobs and movement</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Although mobs in ED1 do not have much HP, many of them have mechanics with very high KO potential. Do not be surprised if you die to any of these.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Death Lotus Assassins</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are by far the most dangerous mobs and are found in 2 areas, after Sanctum Guardian and before Masuta. You do not need to kill them to proceed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At the part after Sanctum, use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectRange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after 'You are no more!' while clearing the 3 Zealots to avoid dying.</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/rwE2Ei3.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 more are found near the barrier before Masuta. You may aggro them while running to the 4 Zealots you need to clear to open the barrier.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectRange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and food in mouth if needed. Teleport out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>after opening the gate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if needing to bank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Don't use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> here if going into Masuta directly as you will need </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for Masuta's hurricane.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/IwHIix8.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Always use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectRange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> when you see them attacking no matter what as they can hit you from a decent distance.</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/WoaCM1c.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Hanto Sellswords</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can be found right after Sanctum Guardian and near the Menaphite Soldiers before Masuta.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is not necessary to kill them to proceed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Beware of their 'Die by the blade!' attack where they spin their spear, dealing very heavy melee damage which can 2-3 hit you if not careful.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Quickly use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and eat or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> them to stop it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Defence pylons</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They attacking using rapid moderate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> beams and are quite long-ranged.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You need to kill 3 of these to access Seiryu.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to go into the Seiryu encounter after Masuta straight as using the bank chest near Seiryu is not practical due to getting harassed by these crystals.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can always teleport out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>after opening the gate to Seiryu</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if needed to stop their aggro.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> right before engaging the first Pylon. Kill it fast to extend </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> before killing 2 more.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to end on high adrenaline and proceed to Seiryu</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/9JmjLtG.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Other noteworthy mobs</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elite Sakadagami: Uses highly damaging </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> abilities which can also stun you. Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> especially if facing multiple of them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elite Sotapanna: Occasionally heals damaged mobs to full using a healing orb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arhats and Anagami: Can follow you into the Sanctum Guardian fight, making it much harder. Teleport out to get rid of them if needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ AoEs by style, generally from most to least viable</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cane">[[File:Hurricane.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cane</nowiki>|<nowiki>cane</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="quake">[[File:Quake.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>quake</nowiki>|<nowiki>quake</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="flurry">[[File:Flurry.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>flurry</nowiki>|<nowiki>flurry</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cleave">[[File:Cleave.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cleave</nowiki>|<nowiki>cleave</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; targeted </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="meteorstrike">[[File:Meteor Strike.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>meteorstrike</nowiki>|<nowiki>meteorstrike</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is extremely good at places with lots of enemies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mechchin">[[File:Mechanised chinchompa.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>|<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rapid">[[File:Rapid Fire.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>|<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mechchin">[[File:Mechanised chinchompa.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>|<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snap">[[File:Snap Shot.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snap</nowiki>|<nowiki>snap</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="ricocaroming">https://files.catbox.moe/8tqkyl.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153635004447.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mechchin">[[File:Mechanised chinchompa.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>|<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="deadshotigneous">https://files.catbox.moe/cpxt7q.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> is good way to clear hordes of enemies fast to avoid getting overwhelmed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="tsunamiincite">https://files.catbox.moe/xkpzfo.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruptblast">[[File:Corruption Blast.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruptblast</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruptblast</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="chaincaroming">https://files.catbox.moe/rnk2pr.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153962684426.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 4TAA using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodbarrage">[[File:Blood Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is very helpful for clears.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="gchaincaroming">https://files.catbox.moe/1gti5r.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> should be used whenever possible if owned for clears, especially with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="omnipowerigneous">https://files.catbox.moe/gsklcq.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Some good places to use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofacceleration">[[File:Powerburst of acceleration (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are as follows:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This helps you avoid taking unnecessary damage from mobs while clearing the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
